testLimits: Actual extracted JobCost load/hooks/JSX synthetic GET tests, not browser/React lifecycle or hosted/mobile integration. Financial API regressions use local synthetic SQLite only.
behavior: Close/unmount/estimate changes invalidate pending expense reads; only latest generation can commit. Old-job refresh callbacks cannot load a different current job.

HTTP, network, malformed JSON/collections/records and invalid or unsafe expense amounts require retry. Preserve last-good records internally; hide cost/profit totals, empty-state claims and cost entry during failed or unknown reads.
Successful reads filter by job ID and validate safe sums; only successful empty results show zero costs. Expense POST handler unchanged.
